create.name: Shiva Rea
create.bio:
Shiva Rea is a yoga teacher who founded Prana Vinyasa, also called Prana Flow, and leads an online school, Samudra Global School for Living Yoga. Her approach weaves vinyasa together with tantra and Ayurveda, and draws on study in the Krishnamacharya lineage, on Kalaripayattu, the martial art of Kerala, which she learned at CVN Kalari, and on world dance and somatic movement. She treats flowing sequences as moving meditation, timed to the rhythms of the sun, moon and seasons, and she has long brought ecstatic and trance dance into yoga settings.

Through the Samudra school she runs an online programme, live and on replay, of weekly salutation practices, new- and full-moon rituals, Shakti-centred flows and a teaching lab, along with a self-paced 300- and 500-hour teacher training in Evolutionary Vinyasa that students can combine with modules on Ayurveda, tantra, bhakti and dance. For around fifteen years she has led retreats at an Ayurvedic centre on the Malabar coast of Kerala, often timed to festivals such as Navratri and Maha Shivaratri, and she also teaches workshops and dance gatherings in southern California and abroad.

courses.title: Living Yoga: Evolutionary Vinyasa Teacher Training (300 and 500 hour)
courses.description: A self-paced teacher training in Prana Vinyasa that begins with core modules on embodying flow and the mandala of salutations, then lets students add electives in tantra, Ayurveda, bhakti or trance dance. Live and recorded sessions run through her online school, with optional modules on retreat.

courses.title: Shakti Tandava: Soma Rasa Vinyasa and Kalarippayatu + Maha Shivaratri (Kerala)
courses.description: A one- or two-week winter retreat on the Malabar coast of Kerala that combines prana vinyasa, meditation, Kalarippayatu, kirtan and sacred text study with visits to nearby temples around Maha Shivaratri. Ayurvedic meals and treatments are part of the stay.

courses.title: Navratri Sacred Embodiment: Fall Shakti Sadhana (Kerala)
courses.description: A women's retreat in Kerala during the Navratri festival, with Shakti-focused prana vinyasa, tantric philosophy, dance, drumming, Sanskrit chanting and meditation near Shiva-Shakti temples.
